note: Rulings on the CoinGecko coins of parts 2 and 4 of the strata rule, read by capture-strata. An exclusion removes a coin whatever CoinGecko's data say; a Cardano-first ruling keeps a coin whose CoinGecko asset_platform_id is another chain, because its Cardano token is the original issuance; a commodity ruling classes a coin as a tokenized commodity, so it belongs to part 4.
